DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph DILG OPINION No. 48 s. 2022 June 3, 2022 HON. JOSE C. VERA CRUZ Sangguniang Bayan Member Municipality of Unisan Province of Quezon Dear Honorable Vera Cruz: This refers to your letter seeking clarifications on matters concerning the Enhanced Municipal Development Council procedures, particularly raising the following issues: I. Can a representative ofa member preside the meeting? 2. Are member's representative allowed to vote? and 3. Can a supplemental budget be passed without violating election policies during election period? On the first and second queries, attention is respectfully directed to Section 107 (b) of the Local Government Code of 1991 which provides for the composition of the Municipal Development Councils (MDC), thus: "Section 107. Xxx (b) The city or municipal development council shall be headed by the mayor and shall be composed of the following members: (I) All punong barangays in the city or municipality; (2) The chairman of the committee on appropriations of the sangguniang panlungsod or sangguniang bayan concerned; (3) The congressman or his representative; and (4) Representatives of non-governmental organizations operating in the city or municipality, as the case may be, who shall constitute not less than one-fourth (1/4) of the members of the fully organized council. Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

The afore-quoted law is clear as to the composition of MDC. It specifically allowed representatives for members of non-governmental organizations and congressional representatives only. In the case of Hongkong and Shanghai Bank vs. Peters, the Supreme Court ruled that where a statute by its terms, is expressly limited to certain matters it may not, by interpretation or constructions, be extended to other matters. This rule on statutory construction is expressed in the familiar maxim expression unius est exlusion alterius. Accordingly, it is this Department's opinion that other than those specified by the Local Government Code of 1991 to be represented by their representatives, other members thereof cannot be allowed to vote through their representatives, let alone preside a meeting. As to the last query, we are of the view that supplemental budget may be passed during election, as the same is not one of those prohibited acts identified by the Commission on Elections in connection with the 09 May 2022 National and Election Elections. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: —MARL-O GAN Undersec ary for Local Government ousLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/jam/anor Engr. ARIEL O.
